clue.text: Help a hundred artists from the east to discover a Greek idyll

indicators.note: in an across clue, coming from the east means reading right to left

parts.note: to help is to aid
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
RA, Royal Academician, stands for artists

explanation.surface: An art lover's quest: aid some painters in finding a pastoral Greek paradise.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue, 'from the east' means read right to left, so the whole string is turned round. RA (Royal Academician) is the usual crossword shorthand for an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Arcadia is the region of Greece that poets idealised as an unspoilt rural paradise.

clue.text: Collect a team say

indicators.note: say tells us to speak the phrase and take the word it sounds like

parts.note: a team, as of rowers or workers, is a crew

explanation.surface: An instruction to gather a squad together, perhaps for a game.
explanation.definitionFit: To accrue is to accumulate or gather up over time, a synonym of collect.

clue.text: Shiny plate given by Switzerland's capital

parts.note: CH is the international vehicle code for Switzerland (Confoederatio Helvetica)
Rome is a capital city

explanation.surface: Gleaming plating offered by the Swiss capital, as if Bern sold car trim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Switzerland's capital' tempts you towards Bern, but the two words do separate jobs: the country's vehicle code, then any capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Chrome is chromium plating, the bright metallic finish on car bumpers and fittings.

clue.text: Shrinks denim? His is ripped

indicators.note: ripped denim is torn apart, so these letters are torn up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A laundry mishap: someone's jeans have shrunk and torn.
explanation.definitionFit: Diminishes means becomes smaller, the same sense as shrinks.

clue.text: Record company's assets, personnel, profits, losses and expenses to begin with

indicators.note: to begin with asks for the opening letter of each of the listed words

explanation.surface: A list of the items on a record label's balance sheet.
explanation.definitionFit: Apple Records is the label founded by the Beatles in 1968.

clue.text: Painful sounds caused by gas lights?

indicators.note: caused by places the cries after the gas that brings them on

parts.note: wind is gas in the digestive tract
ows are cries of pain

explanation.surface: Groans of pain brought on by flatulence, or perhaps by gas lamps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gas lights' reads as old street lamps; split, gas is WIND and lights is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Lights is an old word for windows, the openings that let light into a building.

clue.text: Pasty? Get 17, then I'll show sign of giving up

parts.note: a pasty complexion is pale or white
17-down means more floppy, so to get that way is to droop or flag

explanation.surface: Someone pale and wilting announces they will signal surrender.
explanation.definitionFit: Waving a white flag is the traditional token of surrender in battle.

clue.text: Once found alternatives to knock out gas

indicators.note: knocking out every other letter of the words leaves the alternate letters

explanation.surface: Having found other options, someone sets out to neutralise a gas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'alternatives to knock out' means strike out the odd letters of ONCE FOUND, keeping the second, fourth, sixth and eighth.
explanation.definitionFit: Neon is a noble gas, an element used in glowing signs.

clue.text: Double the amount of work put on my colleague, by gum!

indicators.note: in a down clue, put on means placed above, so the doubled piece comes first
doubling the amount means writing the piece twice over

parts.note: OP, short for opus, is a work
Anax is a fellow setter of the Independent crossword, a colleague of the setter Math

explanation.surface: An overloaded worker exclaims 'by gum!' at a doubled workload.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by gum!' looks like a mild exclamation, but gum is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Opopanax is an aromatic gum resin from a plant of the parsnip family, used in perfumes.

clue.text: Up on charges is one of Murdoch's outfits

parts.note: Sky is the broadcaster long controlled by Rupert Murdoch
wards are charges, people in someone's care

explanation.surface: A news item: one of Murdoch's companies is facing a rise in charges.
explanation.definitionFit: Skywards means towards the sky, i.e. upward.

clue.text: Medic, Dr O'Malley, keeps a collection of computer files

indicators.note: keeps means the doctor's name holds the answer within its letters

explanation.surface: A doctor called O'Malley maintains an archive of digital records.
explanation.definitionFit: A CD-ROM is a compact disc holding read-only data, such as a set of files.

clue.text: Crossword setter gets a couple of looks at extremely geeky study of words

parts.note: Phi is a setter of the Independent crossword

indicators.note: a couple of means the piece appears twice

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look!

indicators.note: extremely asks for the outermost letters of the word

explanation.surface: A puzzle setter glances twice at a nerdy branch of linguistics.
explanation.walkthrough: Lo, as in 'lo and behold', is an old way of saying look.
explanation.definitionFit: Philology is the historical study of language and the development of words.

clue.text: It's natural, like drones protecting a queen

indicators.note: protecting means the first piece surrounds the second to shield it

parts.note: drones are aircraft flown without crew aboard
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is a queen

explanation.surface: In a beehive, male drones guard their queen, which is just nature.
explanation.walkthrough: Drones and queens summon bees, but here drones are pilotless aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: Unmannered means free of affectation, so natural and unaffected in behaviour.

clue.text: Joe Jonas's first meeting with girl

indicators.note: first means take the opening letter of the name

parts.note: Ava is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Joe Jonas, the pop singer, meets a girl, tabloid-style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Joe Jonas' reads as the singer's full name, but Joe stands alone as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Joe and java are both American slang for coffee.

clue.text: Admiring our boatload from Newcastle

parts.note: in Geordie dialect, spoken in Newcastle, our is said and written wor
a shipful is as much as a vessel holds

explanation.surface: A Tyneside skipper boasting about his cargo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from Newcastle' marks the dialect form: Geordies, people from Newcastle upon Tyne, say 'wor' for 'our'.
explanation.definitionFit: Worshipful means showing reverence or adoration, so admiring.

clue.text: An ounce of lard we stir with spoon

indicators.note: stirring with a spoon mixes things up, so these letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A cooking instruction: stir an ounce of lard with a spoon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ounce' looks like a weight, but it is another name for the big cat.
explanation.definitionFit: The ounce is an old name for the snow leopard of Central Asia's mountains.

clue.text: Where you might find head immediately

definitions.meaning: a pimple's head sits on top of the blemish

explanation.surface: A spot-the-location query, with a word for straight away.
explanation.definitionFit: On the spot is an idiom for at once, and literally a pimple's head is on the spot.

clue.text: 'Tis 4 ingredients you need to mix for this sort of soup

indicators.note: to mix says the ingredients' letters are combined into a new order

parts.note: 4 points to 4-down, the record company, a fruit name

explanation.surface: A recipe note: there are four ingredients to blend for this soup.
explanation.walkthrough: '4 ingredients' reads as a count, but 4 is the answer to 4-down.
explanation.definitionFit: Split pea soup is a thick soup made from dried, halved peas.

clue.text: More floppy disks, initially poor, I re-formatted

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of the word
formatting a disk rearranges it, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Computer talk: floppy disks, already poor, have been reformatted.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphenated 're-formatted' splits in two: its first part is fodder and 'formatted' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Droopier means sagging more, a comparative matching more floppy.

clue.text: Displayed by returning exhibitors, e.g. at NEC: "Replacement parts"

indicators.note: returning means the letters are read in the reverse direction
displayed by means the letters are shown within the phrase

explanation.surface: Exhibitors at a trade show advertise their replacement parts.
explanation.walkthrough: The NEC is the National Exhibition Centre near Birmingham, a big trade-show venue.
explanation.definitionFit: Percentages are shares or proportions of a whole, so parts.

clue.text: Indian outfit accommodates Football Association for tour for the big game

indicators.note: accommodates means the outfit takes the abbreviation inside it

parts.note: a sari is a garment worn by women in India
FA is the abbreviation for the Football Association, English football's governing body

explanation.surface: An Indian team hosts English football officials ahead of a big match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the big game' suggests a cup final; it means large wild animals.
explanation.definitionFit: A safari is an expedition to see or hunt large wild animals, known as big game.

clue.text: The ice is broken by IT whizz!

indicators.note: ice that is broken is shattered, so these letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A computer expert breaks the ice at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: A techie is someone expert in technology, especially computing.

clue.text: Picture an honest admission by a swindler

definitions.meaning: an image or representation, as of a saint

definitions.text: an honest admission by a swindler
definitions.meaning: a con artist owning up would say '...'

explanation.surface: A painting and a fraudster's candid confession.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense reads the answer as two words, I CON, what a confessing con man might say.
explanation.definitionFit: An icon is a picture or image, especially a religious painting.

clue.text: Call me in on mishandled meeting about …

indicators.note: about means the meeting goes around the scrambled letters

parts.note: a date is an arranged meeting

indicators.note: mishandled means the letters are handled wrongly and rearranged

explanation.surface: A request to be called in about a botched meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: The trailing ellipsis only joins the surface to 25-across; this clue is complete in itself.
explanation.definitionFit: To denominate is to give a name to, i.e. to call.

clue.text: Work is held back by welfare policy

indicators.note: held back says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A benefits system stops work from going ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: An opera is a musical and dramatic work, Latin opus in the plural.

clue.text: He won't strike a beetle, lacking the guts

indicators.note: lacking the guts means the central letters are taken out

parts.note: the scarab is a beetle, sacred in ancient Egypt

explanation.surface: A cowardly man refuses to strike a beetle, lacking courage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking the guts' suggests cowardice; it removes the middle letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A scab is a worker who refuses to join a strike or takes a striker's place.

clue.text: … original source of first of Patsy Cline (RIP) remixes

indicators.note: first of asks for the opening letter of the name
a remix reworks a recording, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A tribute to the late country singer Patsy Cline, whose songs are remixed.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links this to 22-across but is only for the surface; both clues stand alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A principle is a fundamental truth or origin from which other things derive.

clue.text: Gaudy loud tie

parts.note: F, forte, is the musical direction for loud
to lash is to tie with rope

explanation.surface: A garish, noisy necktie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loud tie' reads as a garish necktie; tie is a verb, to bind.
explanation.definitionFit: Flash is informal for ostentatious or showy, a synonym of gaudy.

clue.text: Killer whale flips to a certain degree, starting to twist like a gymnast

indicators.note: flips means turned over, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: the orca is the killer whale
BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a university degree

indicators.note: starting asks for the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A whale tumbles and twists in the water like an athlete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'like a' is a link: the gymnast is the definition, a performer much like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An acrobat performs feats of balance and agility, much as a gymnast does.

clue.text: Not yet surpassed by ace. It will come back to me

parts.note: A stands for ace in card notation

indicators.note: come back means the letters are read backwards

parts.note: it will contracts to it'll

explanation.surface: An ace remains unbeaten, and is sure it will return to its owner.
explanation.definitionFit: An all-time record is one never beaten in the whole of history.
